chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Abi Abdullah, from his father and Muhammad ibn Isa, from Al-Nadr ibn Suwayd, from Yaqub ibn Shu'ayb, from Abu Baseer, from one of the two Imams (peace be upon them), who said:
Indeed, Allah, Mighty and Majestic, made a house for disobedience, then made a door for the house, then made a lock for the door, then made a key for the lock, so the key of disobedience is wine.
ai.seo_question: What is considered the key to all sins in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi employs a nested metaphorical structure to illustrate how wine serves as the foundational 'key' that unlocks the 'house' of disobedience, a concept central to Shia ethical theology. Scholars emphasize this chain of causality to demonstrate how a single vice can lead to a cascade of moral failures, reinforcing the practical importance of temperance in spiritual development. The narration underscores wine not merely as a prohibited substance but as the primary catalyst for the degradation of human character.

en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Abu Abdullah, from his father and Muhammad Bin Isa, from Al Nazar Bin Suweyd, from Yaqoub Bin Shuayb, from Abu Baseer, 
(It has been narrated) from one of the two (5th or 6th Imam<sup>asws</sup>) having said:

‘Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic Made a house for the disobedience, then Made doors for the house, then Made a lock for the door, then Made a key for the lock, so the key of the disobedience is the (drinking of) wine’.
en.sarwar: 6. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn abu ‘Abd Allah from his father Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from al-Nadr ibn Suwayd from Ya‘qub ibn Shu’ayb from abu Basir who has said the following: “One of the two Imam, (abu Ja‘far or abu ‘Abd Allah), ‘Alayhim al-Salam, has said that

Allah, most Majestic, most Glorious, has made a house for sins. For this house He has made a door, for the door He has made a lock and for the lock He has made a key, the key to disobedience is wine.’”
